additional_info.subject: Internal note
additional_info.body: Internal discussion is going on with Mr.Fernando,and same inform to them as we got from Mr.Eric

This charger was configured and build with a system architecture that was never finished: The option to have single-outlet Dispensers. Later, the Dispenser sub-system was developed only in a dual-outlet variant. Bringing such a dual-outlet Dispenser to a Sicharge D with a single-outlet Dispenser preparation will most likely result in some kind of incompatibility. Such a combination is unheard of as of now. Before offering to the customer at least some kind of feasability check should be conducted.
